dialogues.speaker: Golden Dusk Announcement
dialogues.text: "Today's recommendations: Fresh iced milk, fresh iced mint burst, and fresh iced Grainfruit Meat Soup!"

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "Hey, why do you guys only have iced drinks? Got anything a bit warmer?"

dialogues.speaker: Golden Dusk Announcement
dialogues.text: "Of course! I'm happy to personally prepare some fresh hot milk, fresh hot mint burst, and fresh hot Grainfruit Meat Soup for you!"

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "Now that's more like it... Wait, isn't Grainfruit Meat Soup supposed to be hot in the first place?"
